detail.longDescription: Duke Chronicle: ‘Insane data’: Duke professor Dan Ariely accused of additional research fraud . “Dan Ariely, professor of business administration in the Fuqua School of Business, is once again under scrutiny after an article released Monday found evidence that he likely tampered with or fabricated data in an influential 2002 research paper on procrastination.” https://rbfirehose.com/2026/09/08/insane-data-duke-professor-dan-ariely-accused-of-additional-research-fraud-duke-chronicle/
